area: apps/server/src/user (UserDO and modules; catalog.gen.ts is generated, 358 lines, not audited)
purpose: Per-user Durable Object that owns keys, chats, agents, souls, theme, reminders and routines, memory and initiative loops, extensions, the file index, and browser and Composio connections, exposed as RPC and a websocket.
summary: Credential encryption, key handling, and idempotent alarm delivery are solid and should be frozen. The routines layer has three real gaps: snooze accepts routines it should refuse, deleting a chat leaves its routines armed, and a webhook token can be issued without its lookup row. UserDO is a 1035-line facade of 107 methods, some dead or pass-through.

subareas.name: Credentials and provider sign-in
subareas.why: AES-GCM with AAD bound to user and provider (core/durable/src/crypto.ts:50-76). Writes serialize per provider. Routes return ProviderInfo with last4 only.

subareas.name: Reminders and routines
subareas.why: Delivery is idempotent: deliveryId is id:dueUtc, the advance is conditional on due_utc, and routine_runs has a PK. Gaps: snooze and chat-delete invariants, and a silent webhook-row failure. reminders.ts (677 lines) is proportionate; its pure text code could move out.

subareas.name: Extensions
subareas.why: Secrets sealed per (extension, secret), pinned to declared hosts, scrubbed from responses. Install is reachable only from the human's socket (user-do.ts:809-812).

subareas.name: Chats, agents, souls, theme, overview, limits, sockets
subareas.why: Small, direct SQL with clear caps. Cleanup items only. overview is verified only indirectly (proactive suite).

subareas.name: Memory capture and initiative loops
subareas.why: Judge, capture queue, and nap logic are earned; nap_applied keeps naps idempotent. Usage is written twice, and count() rewrites a JSON blob per call.

subareas.name: Wiring classes
subareas.why: Each has one caller, UserDO. kernel-wiring and routines-wiring carry real logic. home-wiring and extension-wiring are mostly one-line pass-throughs.

subareas.name: UserDO facade
subareas.why: 107 public methods, mixed eager and lazy construction. Two RPCs have no caller. Dev seams are NODE_ENV-gated and fine.

strengths: Ciphertext is bound to user and purpose (crypto.ts:50-76; extensions.ts secret()).
Logs name provider, status, or error class only (memory-capture.ts:112,117,227; turn-context.ts:62).

Alarm delivery is at-least-once but safe: one-off reminders advance with WHERE due_utc = ? (reminders.ts:558-565); routine runs dedupe on the routine_runs PK and room deliveries.seen. reminders.test.ts:69 covers crash-between-delivery.
Webhook tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes (reminders.ts:278, 375).
DO names come from the session or the routine's D1 user_id. No setTimeout in user/.
Dev RPCs and routes are gated by NODE_ENV (dev.ts devOnly; reminders-route.ts:50-51).

problems.title: snooze accepts routines of every trigger
problems.evidence: reminders.ts:498-508 sets due_utc and status='active' on any non-cancelled row. Event, watch, and webhook routines have due_utc 0 (reminders.ts:338-341), and fire() picks any active row with due_utc > 0 (reminders.ts:524). The run then ends 'done' (reminders.ts:562). reminders-route.ts:9 and :60 allow it. Snooze also unpauses a paused routine without resetting fails.
problems.fix: Refuse snooze unless trigger is null or time. Leave status alone for routines. Add a test.

problems.title: Deleting a chat leaves its reminders and routines armed
problems.evidence: user-do.ts:920-930 (apply) on delete only forgets loops. Nothing cancels reminders with that room_id. A routine stops only when a run hits 'gone' (wake-delivery.ts:136, cancel at reminders.ts:455-458). A one-off reminder writes into the deleted room first (room/deliver.ts:85-91). Watches keep fetching.
problems.fix: On delete, cancel active reminders and routines for that room and drop their hooks, in the same transaction.

problems.title: A webhook token can be issued with no working lookup row
problems.evidence: routines-wiring.ts:70-80 inserts the D1 hooks row inside try/catch and only console.errors. createRoutine has already returned the token, so the URL 404s forever.
problems.fix: Fail the create when the D1 insert fails, rolling back the DO row, or retry before returning the token.

problems.title: A refused routine delivery never counts toward auto-pause
problems.evidence: reminders.ts:402-406 logs 'refused' as failed. Only finishRun bumps fails (reminders.ts:415-428), and refused deliveries never reach it.
problems.fix: Count refused in settleRun, or log it as non-failure, so ledger and counter agree.

problems.title: One-off reminders retry forever on a persistent error
problems.evidence: reminders.ts:534-557: any throw from deliver() retries every 30 s. Only routines have fails and MAX_FAILS.
problems.fix: Cap attempts per reminder, then mark failed and notify.

problems.title: Run ledger pruning weakens redelivery dedupe
problems.evidence: reminders.ts:407-412 keeps 20 runs per routine. An event:/hook: occurrence older than that can run again on redelivery.
problems.fix: Accept and document, or keep dedupe keys with a TTL.

problems.title: wiped flag is memory-only
problems.evidence: user-do.ts:859 and :885 set #wiped in memory. After eviction a wiped object accepts upgrades on empty storage (user-do.ts:732-744). Revoked sessions (account-route.ts:67) make it unreachable in practice.
problems.fix: Check a persistent tombstone in fetch(), not only the in-memory flag.

problems.title: Origin guard missing on two cookie routes
problems.evidence: reminders-route.ts and soul-route.ts skip originAllowed; credentials, routines, and loops routes do not. POST/PUT require application/json, which limits the risk.
problems.fix: Add the same check, for consistency.

problems.title: Secret scrub skips values under 6 characters
problems.evidence: extensions.ts:448 redacts only when value.length >= 6, so a short secret echoed back reaches the agent.
problems.fix: Redact any non-empty value, or refuse short secrets in setSecret.

problems.title: The reset snapshot is unbounded
problems.evidence: user-do.ts:997 sends every chat, agent, and home file in one frame.
problems.fix: Measure a large account, then page the file list if needed.

overengineering.title: Dead RPC eventRoutines
overengineering.evidence: user-do.ts:253-255; no caller in apps/ or core/.

overengineering.title: Dead RPC muteChat
overengineering.evidence: user-do.ts:282-285; mute goes through apply() via the chat frame.

overengineering.evidence: import-records.ts (25 lines) runs at user-do.ts:92; schema.ts:52 drops executor_secrets.

overengineering.title: home-wiring is a one-caller class of pass-throughs
overengineering.evidence: home-wiring.ts (69 lines); only commit() and dropAfter() have logic.

overengineering.title: extension-wiring is a one-caller dispatcher
overengineering.evidence: extension-wiring.ts (55 lines), called only from user-do.ts:177-183.
overengineering.why: The switch could live on ExtensionStore.

overengineering.title: keys.ts is a one-constant module
overengineering.evidence: keys.ts (1 line), imported by user-do.ts:58, initiative-loops.ts:13, dev.ts:7.

overengineering.title: Usage bookkeeping written twice
overengineering.why: complete() could call count(). No race today (sync read-write).

reminders.ts mixes reminders, routines, and pure text

overengineering.why: Moving text to routine-text.ts makes it testable without a DO. Not urgent.

overengineering.title: Run ledger, watch fingerprint, webhook match
overengineering.why: Needed for idempotency and watch semantics.

CLI: credentials, provider-login, reminders, routines, routine-triggers, limits, soul, chats, extensions*, account-delete, initiative-loops, proactive (overview), byok. GAPS: no workerd test for a routine time run retried after a crash; snooze on routines; chat delete with live reminders; webhook D1 insert failure; refundAutonomous, chatTasks, composioSignature have no direct test.
